The Swiss commercial register (Zefix data) shows an ACTIVE association (Verein) named 'Speer-Braui', UID CHE-493.081.761, registered at Braendliguet 27, 8722 Kaltbrunn, canton St. Gallen, with the purpose of promoting the variety of beer and spirits in Kaltbrunn and the region; the name, legal form (Verein / non-profit) and place match the Stripe profile exactly, and the same UID is published in the merchant's own Impressum. No dissolution or strike-off is shown. Separately, the federal alcohol authority (BAZG) licence for spirits production could not be checked: a concession is required above 200 litres of pure alcohol per year but there is no public register of concession holders, so licence status is unknown and not scored; the merchant's own 'Ueber uns' page states distilling is carried out by an external distillery. [https://onlineinfo.ch/firma/speer-braui---che-493-081-761/pdf]

Independent sources place the business physically in Kaltbrunn (SG). The regional newspaper Suedostschweiz (16 November 2023) reports on whisky casks maturing in the Grynau fortress and names the Speer-Braui in Kaltbrunn and the two people responsible for the spirit, with roughly 500 litres in storage and a silver award from the Swiss Spirit Revue. The commercial register gives the registered address Braendliguet 27, 8722 Kaltbrunn, and the merchant's own site gives a public shop (Braui-Laden) at Dorfstrasse 11, Kaltbrunn, with dated opening days and event appearances. [https://www.suedostschweiz.ch/schweiz-und-welt/experiment-whiskylagerung-in-einer-festung-ihr-whisky-reift-an-der-grynau-im-militaerbunker-104698]

The representative is listed in the commercial register entry for Speer-Braui (CHE-493.081.761) as president of the board with sole signature authority, alongside a vice-president. The same two names appear as the authorised representatives in the merchant's own Impressum and on its 'Ueber uns' page, and in the 2023 Suedostschweiz article as the people behind the Speer-Braui whisky. The representative therefore matches a named officer in the register, on the organisation's own channels and in independent local news. No home address, date of birth or other personal data was collected, and no people-search or data-broker sources were used. [https://onlineinfo.ch/firma/speer-braui---che-493-081-761/pdf]

The declared URL www.speer-braui.ch loads and is a genuine, actively maintained site for this business: a WooCommerce site titled 'Speer-Braui', tagline 'Brauerei - Whisky- und Rhum-Produktion', with product sections for Bier, Whisky and Rhum, a Festservice (keg and tap-system rental), and a blog with posts dated to 24 October 2026. The Impressum states the contact address Braendliguet 27, 8722 Kaltbrunn (identical to the registered address), the e-mail info@speer-braui.ch (identical to the Stripe account e-mail), the two representatives, and commercial register number CHE-493.081.761. The statement descriptor is the business name and its own domain. [https://www.speer-braui.ch/impressum/]

The declared product description matches what the business observably does. The 'Ueber uns' page states Speer-Braui is a brewery and whisky/rum producer in Kaltbrunn run by the two named officers; it brews its own beer, prepares and ferments the wash for its single malt and its rum, has distillation performed by an external distillery, and handles cask selection, maturation and bottling itself. Revenue channels are observable: an on-site shop at Dorfstrasse 11 Kaltbrunn with published opening days, an online store, gift sets, and a beer/tap-system Festservice for local events. MCC 5499 (miscellaneous food stores) is an acceptable but imprecise fit for an alcoholic-beverage producer with a retail outlet; MCC 5921 (package stores - beer, wine, liquor) would describe the activity more exactly. [https://www.speer-braui.ch/ueber-uns/]

Independent and dated presence well beyond one year, with no complaint, scam or fraud reports found. The association was founded at the end of 2020 per its own chronicle (the whisky project started in 2015 with the first bottling in 2018, and the Kaltbrunn premises at Dorfstrasse 11 were taken over in 2021), it is entered in the Swiss commercial register under CHE-493.081.761, and the Suedostschweiz regional newspaper covered it by name on 16 November 2023 in connection with the Grynau fortress cask-maturation project, including a silver award from the Swiss Spirit Revue. The website carries dated content spanning 2021 through October 2026. [https://www.suedostschweiz.ch/schweiz-und-welt/experiment-whiskylagerung-in-einer-festung-ihr-whisky-reift-an-der-grynau-im-militaerbunker-104698]

A targeted search for the name together with Kloten/Zurich restaurant ownership returned no match; the Kloten restaurants that did appear name other operators. No scam, complaint or fraud report tied to this name was found, and no conflicting business attribution was found. The contact email is a free-mail address whose handle combines the trade name with the German word for till or cash register, which is a point-of-sale term rather than a payment-collection description, and is not by itself contradictory.

MCC 5499 (miscellaneous food stores), the trade name FRIED and the descriptor are internally consistent with a small food outlet or food brand, and nothing observed describes payment collection itself or a digital-goods model with no product. Separately, the descriptor does not contain the trading name FRIED, so a cardholder who bought at a shop branded FRIED would not recognise the statement line without prior knowledge of the website, raising dispute and friendly-fraud exposure.

No independent trace of the business over time was found: no dated reviews, no directory listing with a history, no commercial-register entry, no social posts and no local news coverage mentioning FRIED or Food by Kalkan in Kloten. The local.ch take-away directory for Kloten (29 entries) and the Just Eat Kloten Turkish listing contain no business under either name, and no Google, review-site, social or news mention surfaced across six searches, which for a food business requiring licensed physical premises scores as a 10-point operating contradiction.
